mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `tbl_applications` ( `username`, `application_title`, `start_date`, `deadline_date`, `application_code`, `salary`, `career_code`, `position_code`, `education_gbn_code`, `employment_code`, `working_area`, `role_code`, `content`, `procedure_code`, `delete_yn`, `regist_dt` ) VALUES ( #{applicationRequestDto.username}, -- 회사명 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.applicationTitle}, ''), NULL), -- 채용공고 제목 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.startDate}, ''), NULL), -- 공고 시작일 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.deadlineDate}, ''), NULL), -- 공고 마감일 #{applicationRequestDto.applicationCode}, -- 채용 구분 #{applicationRequestDto.salary}, -- 연봉 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.careerCode}, ''), NULL), -- 경력 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.positionCode}, ''), NULL), -- 직책/직급 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.educationGbnCode}, ''), NULL), -- 학력 #{applicationRequestDto.employmentCode}, -- 근무형태 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.workingArea}, ''), NULL), -- 근무지역 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.roleCode}, ''), NULL), -- 개발 직무 IFNULL(NULLIF(#{applicationRequestDto.content}, ''), NULL), -- 모집부문 #{applicationRequestDto.procedureCode}, -- 전형 절차 'N', -- 삭제 여부 NOW() -- 생성일 );
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(application_no) FROM tbl_applications ORDER BY application_no desc

SELECT application_no, username, application_title, start_date, deadline_date, application_code, salary, career_code, position_code, education_gbn_code, employment_code, working_area, role_code, content, procedure_code, CASE WHEN deadline_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(deadline_date, CURDATE()) END AS day FROM tbl_applications WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo};
SELECT username, name, email, phone, content, birth, address, address_detail, zip_code, ceo_name, homepage, employees, sale, role FROM tbl_companys WHERE username=#{username};

SELECT a.application_no, a.username, c.name, a.application_title, a.start_date, a.deadline_date, a.application_code, a.salary, a.career_code, a.position_code, a.education_gbn_code, a.employment_code, a.working_area, a.role_code, a.content, a.procedure_code, CASE WHEN a.deadline_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(a.deadline_date, CURDATE()) END AS DAY, if(l.like_code = 'S', 1, 0) AS bookmarkCheck FROM tbl_applications a JOIN tbl_companys c ON a.username = c.username left JOIN tbl_likes l ON a.application_no = l.like_id AND l.username = #{username} AND l.like_code = 'S'
c.username = #{username}
